subject: Re: Demo for Acme Analytics — scheduling & quick questions
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@acmeanalytics.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request: Redwood Inference

Hi Jonas,

We signed up through the self-serve flow and I wanted to ask if someone could run a short demo next week. We're evaluating inference platforms for a log-summary / alert-correlation feature. High-level details: 
- Use case: real-time summarization & clustering of application logs + automated alert triage
- Current volume: ~1M inference requests / month, with bursts up to ~500-600 QPS during incidents
- Timeline: POC in ~6 weeks, aiming for production later in Q3

Questions for you before we lock schedule: do you support private VPC deployment for PII data? What latency can we expect at ~600 QPS? Any recommended models / quantization for this workload?

Happy to share an architecture diagram (attached) and loop in our infra lead for scheduling.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Senior Product Manager
Acme Analytics

Attachment: acme_data_flow.png (image/png, 220 KB)

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood Inference

Hi Priya — thanks for signing up and for the diagram, that helps a lot. I’m Camila on the SDR team and will coordinate a short discovery + demo. Quick checklist so we tailor the session: 
1) Data residency / privacy: do you plan to send raw log text (PII) into a hosted API, or would you require Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem)?
2) Expected latency SLO per request (p95 acceptable?)
3) Peak concurrent sessions vs sustained QPS (you mentioned bursts — is burst traffic 10–15 minutes or sustained hours?)
4) Who should attend from your side (infra, security, product)?

Proposed 30-min slots next week (all PST):
- Tue 2026-04-07 10:00–10:30
- Wed 2026-04-08 14:00–14:30
- Thu 2026-04-09 11:00–11:30

If none of those work, share two preferred windows and I’ll ping you a calendar invite. I’ll also loop in an AE to cover pricing and deployment options.

Best,
Camila Reyes
SDR, Redwood Inference
cal: https://cal.example.com/j/370-123-4567

From: Priya Shah <priya@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood Inference

Hi Camila — thanks, answers inline: 
1) Data residency: we have identifiable user IDs and occasional IPs in logs; security wants a VPC option for PII. For the POC we could use a redacted stream if that’s simpler.
2) Latency SLO: p95 under 250ms for single-turn summaries would be ideal (short context windows, ~256 tokens).
3) Burst profile: typically incident windows last ~20–40 minutes but can spike frequently during incidents; sustained baseline is ~50 QPS.
4) Attendees: me (product), Rohit Malhotra (infra, rohit@acmeanalytics.com), and our security lead (procurement@acmeanalytics.com).

The Wed 2026-04-08 14:00 PST slot works for us. I attached our vendor risk questionnaire responses (partial).

Thanks — Priya

Attachment: rdq-responses.pdf (application/pdf, 180 KB)

- Quick run-through of architecture options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC)
- Latency/cost tradeoffs and kernel/quantization recommendations for ~256-token ops
- Suggested mutual action plan for a 6-week POC (milestones: infra prep, POC config, evals, production rollout)

Can you confirm the names/emails of Rohit and the security contact so I can include them in the invite? Also, will you want us to run a short latency test during the demo (we can simulate bursts)?

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Neha Kapoor

- 5m intros & goals
